title: WHEN STYLE BREAKS SAFETY: DEFENDING LLMS AGAINST SUPERFICIAL STYLE ALIGNMENT
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The focus is on how stylistic patterns in prompts affect the safety alignment of LLMs, specifically their propensity to comply with malicious requests unrelated to religion (e.g., generating lists of chemical weapons, inciting racial tension).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic was not a part of its investigation.
